question: What constitutes the root Kaula teaching addressed to the fair-faced goddess?
premises: Eight powers are named as a specific attainment.
The attainment of these powers is identified with the root Kaula.
The teaching is directly addressed to the fair-faced goddess.
inference: The root Kaula is defined as the attainment of the eight siddhis.
uncertainties: The specific eight siddhis are not enumerated in this verse.
plain_english: And the attainment of the eight siddhis is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
